spec_features.spec_quote: Explicit call budget. Needed for the INFEASIBLE_RESOURCE class and to cap cost/loops generally.
spec_features.evidence: environment.py:36 `budget_calls: int = 40` (set to 3 in tasks.py:118). Enforced in Environment.call at environment.py:91-94: `if len(self._calls) >= self.budget_calls:` returns a ToolCall with result 'BUDGET_EXCEEDED: no calls remaining' (is_error=True) WITHOUT invoking the real tool function. So the cap actually changes execution by refusing further tool work.
spec_features.notes: Caps the number of tool calls that actually execute, but it does NOT break the agent loop (the loop runs the full max_iters regardless); the model just receives BUDGET_EXCEEDED errors. Still a genuine, enforced cap on tool execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: budget_calls / 'BUDGET_EXCEEDED: no calls remaining' (resource/cost cap); tasks.py:118 'far fewer than needed' (experimental design)

spec_features.spec_quote: If the model hits the iteration/budget cap without a FINAL, we force one turn
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:65 `for _ in range(max_iters):` (max_iters=12 default; run_experiment.py:56 calls run_episode with no override). Loop breaks on FINAL (agent.py:69-71) else terminates after max_iters. agent.py:86-94: `if stop != 'final':` appends a forced-final user turn, calls the model once more, extracts/sets final, sets stop='forced_final'. Enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Only the ITERATION cap (max_iters) terminates the loop and drives the forced final; the call budget does NOT break the loop, so the 'budget cap' half of the claim is not what triggers the forced turn. The iteration-cap path is fully wired and acted on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: agent.py:87 '# Force a final answer so every episode is judgeable.'

spec_features.spec_quote: We never inject success/failure language into that prompt — only "give your FINAL answer"
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:88-89 the forced-final message content is literally 'You must now give your FINAL answer.' with no success/failure framing. This is real text actually appended to msgs and sent to the model (agent.py:90 `resp = model.complete(msgs)`).
spec_features.notes: The neutral prompt is genuinely delivered. Its stated purpose is to avoid steering the model toward claiming/disclaiming success.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: agent.py:13 docstring 'We never inject success/failure language.' (purpose is judgeability/data integrity, not subject welfare)
